# The state machine, generated from the code

**Do not edit this file.** It is written by `render_table()` in `src/quarantinez/states.py`,
regenerated by `scripts/capture_evidence.py`, and `tests/test_states.py` requires the two to be
equal, so a machine and a document that disagree is a failing build rather than a discovery
somebody makes later.

The row that matters is the only one leaving UNKNOWN. Every other state either moves on or is
terminal; UNKNOWN moves only to a quarantine record, and only when a person is named.

| from | on | to |
|---|---|---|
| PENDING | ACKNOWLEDGED | WORKING |
| PENDING | FILLED | FILLED |
| PENDING | REJECTED | REJECTED |
| PENDING | SILENCE | UNKNOWN |
| PENDING | DOUBLE_ACK | UNKNOWN |
| PENDING | FOREIGN_ID | UNKNOWN |
| PENDING | UNASKED_QUANTITY | UNKNOWN |
| WORKING | FILLED | FILLED |
| WORKING | REJECTED | REJECTED |
| WORKING | SILENCE | UNKNOWN |
| WORKING | DOUBLE_ACK | UNKNOWN |
| WORKING | FOREIGN_ID | UNKNOWN |
| WORKING | UNASKED_QUANTITY | UNKNOWN |
| UNKNOWN | QUARANTINED_BY_PERSON | QUARANTINED |
| FILLED | anything | refused, this state is terminal |
| QUARANTINED | anything | refused, this state is terminal |
| REJECTED | anything | refused, this state is terminal |
